committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal agency personnel in DHS, State, and intelligence community, as well as members of Congress.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Homeland Security, in consultation with the Secretary of State and the Director of National Intelligence, shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees

dimensions.assessment: Requires producing classified reports and briefings on foreign terrorist threats in 19 designated countries.
dimensions.evidence: submission of each assessment of terrorism threats required under subsection (a) shall be submitted in classified form

dimensions.assessment: Identifies potential resource needs to counter threats, but specifies no direct appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: An identification of any additional resources required to counter terror threats

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a recurring reporting requirement on executive agencies concerning major non-NATO allies.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act and biennially thereafter, the Secretary of Homeland Security... shall submit

dimensions.assessment: Permanent requirement for biennial reports following enactment.

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Homeland Security to submit periodic classified threat assessments regarding specific terrorist organizations in major non-NATO ally countries.
